content: In this work, the model predicts the tags INLINEFORM0 for the tokens in a word sequence INLINEFORM1 where INLINEFORM2 is the sequence size and INLINEFORM3 , INLINEFORM4 denote the token and its tag at timestep INLINEFORM5 , respectively. Each token INLINEFORM6 consists of a word, its POS and its type. There are five defined word types: English, Thai, punctuation, digits, and spaces.
